limitations: Geometry PNGs contain the actual prop-stage alpha; they are unoccluded projected silhouettes, not a neutral shaded material study.
Scene PNG is the existing diagnostic canvas conversion of a floating scene target, clamped to [0,1] for display; it is not a lossless HDR buffer dump.
Torch on/off separates an existing illumination contribution; it does not isolate all materials, lights or atmospheric effects.
Final PNG is the actual world canvas through the current dither/acquisition/post path; game DOM/HUD is outside that canvas.

geometry.label: Unoccluded projected geometry; no material/neutral-shading or final-dither claim.
